description: The thin bar under the composer in the Baude main window's chat column: from the left a working indicator, the chat's host, the folder and last-turn summary, a background-tasks button, what the chat has spent, and the context meter at the far right.

parts.name: working dots
parts.shows: While a turn runs: three dots stepping •, ••, ••• and again every 0.35 s (the unlit dots take their room invisibly, so nothing next to them moves). Not there, and takes no room, when idle. Holds still in a window that is not being looked at.

parts.name: host
parts.shows: The host the chat lives on, by name, in monospace: "local" for this machine, else the other host's name.
text: The host this chat lives on: its files, and its tools

actions.does: Tooltip "The host this chat lives on: its files, and its tools", with the host's address in brackets for another host; then, for a chat under a subscription account, a line "Account: <name>"

decisions.said: ChatGPT started work on a providers screen to separate work and personal accounts (the owner's request to finish it; review: a chat's account must be visible)
decisions.rule: Every app shows the account a chat runs under: its status bar host tooltip ("Account: <name>"), Copy Transcript's header ("Account"), Meta's list of chats; a sign-in card in a chat under a Claude account replaces that account's token, never the CLI's own sign-in

parts.name: folder and last turn

decisions.said: in and out before the token counts can be a down arrow and an up arrow
decisions.rule: Every app writes a turn's tokens as ↓ read and ↑ written

decisions.said: A turn's in/out tokens should use the same k/M units as the context count, e.g. 3.9M not 3931407 (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: Every app writes token counts in k/M units (950, 12.4k, 3.9M), the same as the context count: under 1000 a plain number

parts.shows: Takes the room left, one line, cut with … at the end. The chat's folder as people say it (home shown as ~, "~/projects/x"), plus " (worktree <name>)" when the chat works in a git worktree; for another host's chat, that folder as its host says it. After three spaces, the last turn's summary: "<N> turns · <seconds>s · ↓ <tokens> / ↑ <tokens> tok" (tokens as 950, 12.4k, 1.2M) after each finished turn; "<N> tools" right after claude starts; blank for a network chat just attached.

parts.name: background tasks button
parts.shows: Shown only while background things run: a flat button "⚙ 2 background processes · 1 subagent running" (singular "1 background process"/"1 subagent"; a part with none is left out).

actions.does: Tooltip: each running task's description (or its id), one per line, then "Click to open the side panel"
Opens the side panel on Subagents when a subagent is running, else on Processes

parts.name: cost
parts.shows: Right-aligned label of what this chat has spent, "$0.0125" (four decimals), never cut short. For a model run on the user's own machines that adds nothing per turn, "$0.00 (local)" until something is spent. A resumed chat carries on from its recorded cost.

decisions.said: For local models (MLX or Ollama on the mesh) the dollar figure doesn't show up (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: Every app always shows what a chat has spent, never cut short by a long folder; for a model run on the user's own machines it reads "$0.00 (local)" until something is spent

parts.name: context meter

decisions.said: No need for the word context left of the bar: the bar says what it is
decisions.rule: Every app draws the context meter as the bar alone, with no word before it

decisions.said: An MLX model didn't report its context filling as it read large amounts of text; propagate it where possible
decisions.rule: Every app's context meter fills as the turn runs for every model that reports its use (Claude's, and a provider's such as MLX through pi), not only at the turn's end.

decisions.said: Draw the context count inside the bar, its colour flipping where the fill ends (dark over the fill, light after), and drop the percentage since the bar shows it (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: Every app draws the context count ("24k / 200k") inside the bar, in the background colour over the fill and the text colour past it, with no percentage beside it (the percentage is in the tooltip)

decisions.said: On the phone the used-context count never fills in, and it matters (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: Every app shows the context count its chat's host lists for the session (Session's context, the host asking the session's agent as it starts, through each turn, as a turn ends, after a compaction and after a model change, and keeping it while the agent is stopped): an app never asks the agent itself, so a chat opened on any app shows what was last used, not "— / 200k".

parts.shows: A 110 px wide, 16 px high bar at the far right. The count "24k / 200k" is drawn inside the bar (small, tabular figures): in the window background colour over the filled part, in the text colour after it. The fill is the accent colour up to 60 %, amber (warning) past 60 %, red past 85 %. Past the window ("12.4k / 8.2k") the bar is full. After a turn ended with claude saying the prompt is too long, the bar is full too. The count is what the chat's host lists for it (Session's context), so it is there as the chat opens, its agent running or not; the host refreshes it at most once a second during a turn, as the turn ends, after a compaction and when the model changes.

actions.does: Tooltip (it is a tooltip, there is no popover): "Context window usage" then the percentage and a line per category of what fills it ("Messages: 160k", categories with no tokens or deferred ones left out): "Context window usage: 90%" + categories. Before the session has said, "Context window usage", the model's window "{n} tokens" when known, and "What's used is said once its session starts"

states.name: new chat
states.shows: No dots, host "local", folder only, cost $0.0000, context shows "— / <the model's window>" (or "—" when its window isn't known yet)

decisions.said: As far as possible, a model's max context should be shown before its session starts
decisions.rule: Every app's context meter shows the model's window ('— / 200k') before the session has said what it uses, wherever the window is known.

states.name: working
states.shows: Dots stepping; tasks button when background tasks run

states.name: window without a limit
states.shows: Some models report use but no window: no bar; the label reads "context: 24k" ("context —" while unknown)

states.name: context high
states.shows: Bar amber past 60 %, red past 85 %; at full, "Context Exhausted" appears over the composer (see Composer)

states.name: another host's chat
states.shows: Host name and that host's folder path in place of local ones

removed.name: model id ("claude-opus-5-5") beside the folder and cost
removed.why: The owner: the model slug in the bottom bar is redundant, as the header already names the model (paraphrased)
